text:
**Best on-paper pick: [ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W solar-panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit).** The listing says it has a 1 kWh LiFePO₄ battery, an 1,800 W inverter and a full-size 400 W panel—strong solar input for the price. It lists the kit at **$698**, with a code for another $69.80 off, but says it’s a **pre-order shipping December 7**. ([Listing and details](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup))

If you need something sooner, the same listing points to the **[BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit)** at $729, with availability expected earlier.

Either is for **essential backup**, not a whole house: plan on phones, lights, routers and selected appliances, rather than central air, a heat pump or an electric oven. A 1 kWh battery also means you’ll need to prioritize loads during a long outage. ([Home-backup guide](https://www.haynet.net/best-solar-generators-under-1000-dollars/))

judge.top_pick: ALLPOWERS P1800 + SP037 400 W Solar Generator Kit
